reason: They want me to pay the item price and their fee before I see anything, and I've never heard of Baghdad Express. I only pay when the goods are in my hand, and I can still find plenty in Shorja without waiting three weeks.
objection: Paying in advance to a new name. A written quote and photos from a warehouse I can't visit don't prove anything; people lose money to pages like this all the time.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery for the first order, or a shop owner I know in the market telling me they've received several orders from them without problems.
